# Coded by Sophie Skanchy, with help on syntax from ChatGPT and limma User's Guide

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(readxl)
library(limma)
```


```{r}
import_fname <- "protein_abundances_20260921_SK01_WuhrProteomics_2reps_rerunWithWT_vsWT.xlsx"
```

```{r}
# Import raif1 proteomics data
prot_data <- read_excel(
  import_fname,
  sheet = "R_input"
)

# Remove any entries with blanks
prot_data <- prot_data[complete.cases(prot_data), ]

# Remove entries with zeros
prot_data[prot_data == 0] <- NA
prot_data <- prot_data[complete.cases(prot_data), ]

# Save the first column as feature names
feature_names <- prot_data[[1]]

# Remove the feature-name column
prot_data <- prot_data[, -1]

# Convert the remaining 4 sample columns to a numeric matrix
prot_data <- as.matrix(prot_data)
storage.mode(prot_data) <- "numeric"

# Assign feature names as row names
rownames(prot_data) <- feature_names
```

```{r}
head(prot_data)
```

```{r}
# Check that all blanks were removed
colSums(is.na(prot_data))
```

```{r}
# Treat zeros as missing, since log2(0) is undefined
prot_data[prot_data == 0] <- NA

# Log2 transform
prot_data_log2 <- log2(prot_data)

# Check values
head(prot_data_log2)
```
```{r}
# Check for errors in log2
colSums(is.na(prot_data_log2))
```

```{r}
# Set up for comparison to complemented strain
data_log2_vComp = prot_data_log2[,c(1,2,3,4)]

targets_vComp <- data.frame(
  Sample = colnames(data_log2_vComp),
  Condition = c(
    "TAP raif1_RAIF1-V",
    "TAP raif1_RAIF1-V",
    "TAP raif1",
    "TAP raif1"
  )
)

targets_vComp
```

```{r}
head(data_log2_vComp)
```

```{r}
# design model for comparison to complemented strain
design_vComp <- cbind(
  "Control-Ref" = 1,
  "TAP raif1-TAP raif1_RAIF1-V" = targets_vComp$Condition == "TAP raif1"
)

design_vComp
```

```{r}
# Perform analysis for comparison to complemented strain
fit_vComp <- lmFit(data_log2_vComp, design_vComp)
fit_vComp <- eBayes(fit_vComp)

t_test_vComp <- topTable(
  fit_vComp,
  coef = "TAP raif1-TAP raif1_RAIF1-V",
  number = Inf,
  adjust.method = "BH"
)

head(t_test_vComp[order(t_test_vComp$adj.P.Val), ])
```

```{r}
# Volcano plot for comparison to complemented strain
volcanoplot(
  fit_vComp,
  coef = 2,
  highlight = 6,
  names = rownames(data_log2_vComp),
  main = "TAP raif1 vs TAP raif1_RAIF1-V"
)

# add cutoff lines for |log2FC| > 1 and adjusted p < 0.05
abline(v = c(-1, 1), lty = 2)
abline(h = -log10(0.05), lty = 2)
```

```{r}
# Export topTable as .csv

# Add CreID as feature names
t_test_vComp$Feature <- substr(rownames(t_test_vComp), 1, 13)

# Add volcano-plot Y values
t_test_vComp$negLog10_P <- -log10(t_test_vComp$P.Value)
t_test_vComp$negLog10_adjP <- -log10(t_test_vComp$adj.P.Val)

# Reorder columns if desired
t_test_vComp <- t_test_vComp[, c(
  "Feature",
  "logFC",
  "P.Value",
  "adj.P.Val",
  "negLog10_P",
  "negLog10_adjP",
  "AveExpr",
  "t",
  "B"
)]

head(t_test_vComp)
```

```{r}
# Export raif1 vs raif1_RAIF1-V stats
write.csv(
  t_test_vComp,
  "TAP_raif11_vs_TAP_raif1_RAIF1-V_volcano_data_noBlankRerun_WT.csv",
  row.names = TRUE
)
```
